_doc: Power-of-1 / ROI (docs/design/power-of-1-roi.md). Every number the roi/ package uses lives here or in config/economics/<vertical>.json; nothing in roi/ carries its own. Loader raises on a missing key.

bases.measured: from logged outcomes and closed interventions on this tenant (cited by intervention id / outcome node id) or Wizard B's hindsight run
bases.derived: arithmetic over the tenant's own data: account revenue, the catalog and the weights actually applied, the journey
bases.assumed: an economics parameter from config/economics/<vertical>.json, labelled with its basis sentence; never summed with measured

priority._doc: risk_factor = sum(weight * factor) over the four inputs, each factor in [0,1]; revenue_weighted = revenue * max(risk_factor, opportunity_factor). lens = protect when risk_factor >= protect_override_risk (an account being lost is protected first, whatever its upside), else the larger factor; the other lens is reported as secondary_lens when its factor clears list_floor.
priority._leading_note: aligned / leading_only / no label fall back to band_factor of the kpi_only (aligned) or qual (leading_only) band; nothing scored = 'unknown'

attribution._doc: signal role (taxonomy) -> pillar role (catalog pillar_roles). Resolved per vertical through vertical_registry.role(); a role the vertical has no pillar for is reported under 'unmapped', never guessed.

scenarios._doc: CS investment as a share of revenue (positioning memo: 0.3% reactive today, 1-2.5% proactive). Break-even lift = share / retention_sensitivity_per_health_point, in portfolio health points.
